body.name: Covariate-design class and outcome-inference subclass
body.construction: Let \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{PSRR}}^{x}\) be the class of deterministic triangular arrays \((x_{ni})_{i=1}^n\), indexed by even \(n\), with fixed \(k\), such that \(n^{-1}\sum_i x_{ni}=0\), \(\sup_{n,i}\|x_{ni}\|\le K_0\), \(S_{xx,n}\) converges entrywise to a finite matrix, and \(\liminf_n\lambda_{\min}(S_{xx,n})\ge c_x>0\).  The design attached to every member is equal allocation on \(\mathcal A_n\), uniform initialization, fixed \(a>0\), fixed finite \(\gamma\ge0\), and the original first-entry PSRR rule in \(\mathrm{def{:}original\mbox{-}psrr}\).  Let \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{PSRR}}\) be the outcome-inference subclass consisting of arrays \((x_{ni},Y_{ni}(0),Y_{ni}(1))_{i=1}^n\) whose covariate projection belongs to \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{PSRR}}^{x}\), whose potential outcomes are fixed under assignment with no interference, for which \(\sup_{n,i}\{\|x_{ni}\|+|Y_{ni}(0)|+|Y_{ni}(1)|\}\le K_0\), the finite-population covariance matrix of \((x_{ni}^{\mathsf T},Y_{ni}(0),Y_{ni}(1))^{\mathsf T}\) converges entrywise to a finite matrix, and \(\liminf_n v_n\ge c_s>0\).  Thus \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{PSRR}}^{x}\) is the outcome-free covariate-design class, while \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{PSRR}}\) is the subclass on which the joint residual and causal-inference conclusions are asserted.
